ValidationRule.description: Possible Systemic issue description and category fileds are mandatory when a complaint is flagged as possible systemic issue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), ISPICKVAL(IDR_Is_Common__c,'Yes'), OR( ISBLANK(IDR_Systemic_Issue_Description__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Systemic_Issue_Category__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select Why is this a possible systemic issue? and Possible Systemic Issue Category if this is a possible systemic issue
